_readme: INSTALLATION / LABOR (separate from window price). types[].price = install price PER WINDOW. surcharges[] are per-window add-ons: the line total is amount × that line's quantity, and they are NOT part of the labor price and NOT discounted by promo codes. stuccoRepair is an optional estimate line at price × its own quantity (the estimate screen defaults that quantity to the window count). jobExtras are flat job-level lines. Frame types in data/frame-types.json point here: zbar (retrofit / jump frame) -> standard, nailfin -> stucco-fin, block -> block. 'custom' lets the rep type a labor price. A rep can also override the labor price on any window; add-ons still add on top.
